name: Brainstorm fictional power systems and supernatural abilities
description: Users asked to brainstorm and detail specific fictional power systems, magic mechanics, supernatural abilities, and enhancement items for original or existing characters within various game, anime, and literary franchises. Some requests focused on generating lists of unique or overpowered concepts, such as devil fruits or paramecia, while others explored the functional logic and limitations of new cosmic or technological powers.
